title: Tea for two
两个人一起喝茶

sentences: Can't you come in and have tea now, Peter?
彼得，你现在能进来喝茶吗？
Not yet. I must water the garden first.
还不能。我得先给花园浇水。
Do you have to water it now?
你一定得现在浇吗？
I'm afraid I must. Look at it! It's terribly dry.
恐怕我得现在浇。你看看，干得厉害。
What a nuisance!
真讨厌！
Last summer it was very dry, too.
去年夏天也是干得很。
Don't you remember?
你记得了吗？
I had to water it every day.
我不得不每天浇水。
Well, I'll have tea by myself.
好吧，我一个喝茶了。
That was quick! Have you finished already?
好快啊！你已经浇完了？
Yes. Look out of the window.
是的。你看看窗外。
It's raining!
下雨了！
That means you don't need to water the garden.
这就是说，你不必给花园浇水了。
That was a pleasant surprise.
这是意想不到的好事。
It means I can have tea, instead.
这意味着我反倒可以喝茶了。

words: 意味着，意思是（过去式/过去分词）
